name: dependency-sentinel
description: Flags typosquatted or brand-new packages before npm, pip or cargo installs them.

minAgeDays.title: Minimum package age (days)
minAgeDays.description: Hold back packages first published fewer than this many days ago.

minVersions.title: Minimum releases
minVersions.description: Hold back packages with fewer releases than this.

timeoutMs.title: Registry timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a registry before letting the install through with a notice.

checkRegistry.title: Ask the registries
checkRegistry.description: Look packages up on npm, PyPI, crates.io and the Go proxy. Off: only the offline typosquat check runs.
